analysis.reason: RSI는 과매도 구간에서 벗어났으나 50 이상으로 안착하지 못함. MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이나 여전히 음수 구간. ADX 23.1로 추세 형성 초기 단계로 방향성 확정은 아직 이름. 5일 연속 변동률은 -0.51%, -2.32%, -0.48%, -3.37%로 하락세 지속 후 오늘 +2.87% 반등했으나 거래량비 0.79로 힘이 부족함. 52주 저가 $252.84 대비 5.2% 위치로 여전히 낮은 수준. 스윙 지지선 $259.37, 저항선 $302.07 사이 횡보 구간으로 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI has exited oversold territory but has not yet retested above 50. MACD histogram shows improvement but remains negative. ADX at 23.1 indicates an early stage of trend formation, with direction not yet confirmed. The 5-day price change sequence (-0.51%, -2.32%, -0.48%, -3.37%, +2.87%) shows a recent rebound on low volume (0.79 ratio). The current price is 5.2% above the 52-week low of $252.84. The stock is trading in a range between the swing support at $259.37 and resistance at $302.07, warranting a wait-and-see approach.

[지지·저항 구조]
· 스윙 지지선 ($259.37): 52주 저가 및 볼린저 하단 근접 레벨 기반
· 스윙 저항선 ($302.07): SMA20 및 피벗 R1 근접 레벨 기반
· 5일/20일 고가·저가 패턴: 횡보 구간, Higher Low 미확인
[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.79배): 움직임의 신뢰도 위축 진단
· 현 구간 진단: 축적 구간, 지지선 $259.37 회복 및 저항선 $302.07 돌파 시 매수 고려
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current Price ($275.71) vs SMA5/20/50 ($273.21/$306.97/$323.42): attempting short-term upward reversal, confirming mid-term downtrend.
· Position vs SMA100/200 ($313.94/$395.46): maintaining strong mid-to-long-term downtrend.
· 52-week position (5.2%) + diagnosing current price near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI Trajectory (32.8→33.0): attempting to enter neutral zone after exiting oversold, weak directional momentum.
· MACD Histogram Trajectory (-5.5546→-4.8019): weak bearish reversal signal, improving but still negative.
· Bollinger Band Current Price Position (Mid-band $306.97): diagnosing sideways movement near the mid-band.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing Support ($259.37): based on 52-week low and proximity to lower Bollinger band.
· Swing Resistance ($302.07): based on proximity to SMA20 and Pivot R1.
· 5-day/20-day High/Low Pattern: sideways range, Higher Low unconfirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume Ratio (0.79x): diagnosing low confidence in price movement.
· Current Phase Diagnosis: accumulation phase, consider buying upon recovery of support at $259.37 and breach of resistance at $302.07.
